title: Ships 15 MCP tools, well beyond the minimal spec
evidence: src/BSTools.m:152-578 registers search_matches, head_to_head, team_stats, team_profile, standings, cup_bracket, team_rankings, biggest_wins, league_statistics, compare_seasons, find_derbies, search_players, player_details, players_by_club, dataset_info
suggestion: No action; surfaced for cross-run comparison.

title: Cross-file fixture de-duplication and merging
evidence: src/BSDataStore.m:234-257 merges the same fixture across overlapping CSVs (e.g. a 2019 pair remembers 3 source files; tests/BSTests.m:99) and backfills scores/stage/extra stats
suggestion: No action; a correctness strength, verified by the 380-matches-per-season test (tests/BSTests.m:94-95).

title: FIFA dataset covers only a subset of Brazilian clubs
evidence: src/BSTools.m:485 — Flamengo, Palmeiras, Corinthians and São Paulo are absent from fifa_data.csv; the tool returns an explanatory message rather than an error, and tests/BSTests.m:204-205 asserts this behaviour
suggestion: Data limitation, not a code defect; already communicated to the user in tool output.

title: Player position grouping is heuristic
evidence: src/BSDataStore.m:28-35 positionGroup maps by suffix (ends-in-B -> defender, ends-in-M -> midfielder) plus an explicit forward/GK list
suggestion: Adequate for FIFA position codes; note that exotic codes fall through to 'unknown'.
